venues.name: Black Squirrel Club
venues.coverage: Live site calendar Oct 26 – Nov 27 2026 (dated event URLs, TicketLeap); past dates from the Songkick gigography (sparse) and Heart of Jazz / Jazz Near You snippets for 2025
venues.notes: The only 'Black Squirrel' music venue within an hour of Lambertville (about 50 min). It is a Fishtown listening room: a weekly Monday jazz jam, Latin and samba jams, jazz quartets, bluegrass nights and an occasional indie bill. Jams and solo sets were left out. Heart of Jazz is behind Cloudflare and the Wayback Machine was refusing connections, so 2025 is thin.

venues.name: Johnny Brenda's
venues.coverage: Jan 2025 – Apr 2027: live RockHouse/Etix events list plus 24 Wayback captures of /events/, /events/page/2/ and the homepage; Jan 2025 gaps filled from Songkick (venue 254)
venues.notes: Every act on every bill: the headliner title plus the support line, split on commas, '+', 'w/' and 'with'. Dropped dance parties, DJ, trivia, comedy, drag and cancelled shows. Solo singer-songwriters are still in, because they can't be told apart from bands without looking up each act. All-caps names were converted to title case.

venues.name: Moravian Pottery & Tile Works (TileWorks)
venues.coverage: Jan 2025 – Nov 2026: Wayback captures of /events (Jan, Feb, May, Jun, Jul 2025), the live /events and store pages for 2026, and Patch/TileLetter/store snippets for Thanksgiving 2025; nothing seen for Oct 2025 – May 2026 apart from Thanksgiving
venues.notes: Series: 'A Night of Song' in the Big Room (mostly solo songwriters, which were skipped), Bluegrass at TileWorks (three Sunday shows each summer: June, July, September), the Thanksgiving Eve bluegrass party (46th annual in 2026), plus Celtic and party nights.

venues.name: The Starving Artist Café
venues.coverage: one dated 2025 bill from press; Bandsintown (venue 10422109) returns 403
venues.notes: About 10 minutes from Lambertville. Chef and musician Tod Ellis runs this 35-seat café with blues, bluegrass and country, and the 'Breakfast With JB Kline' Facebook Live show broadcasts from it on Friday mornings. Its old WordPress site (starvingartistcafestockton.wordpress.com) has been deleted. Bandsintown and Hypebot list mostly solo acts (Gabe Parsons residency, J Candeed, Dan Strauss) plus New Yacht City, but no date for New Yacht City could be confirmed.

venues.name: Maxwell's on Main (MOM's)
venues.coverage: Live Squarespace 'Live Events' store (Oct–Nov 2026) plus one Wayback capture (Oct 2026); Songkick (venue 1513178) has nothing after 2023 except one solo duo in Apr 2026
venues.notes: About 25 min from Lambertville, so this is the right Maxwell's (not Hoboken). It has an upstairs ballroom with the Craft Culture concert series, a Sunday jazz series, line dancing and drag nights. Past events drop off the site, and Patch says bookings are announced mainly on social media and in email blasts. The 2025-10-23 Chris Lyons record release (solo) was skipped.

venues.name: Kung Fu Necktie
venues.coverage: Jan 2025 – Dec 2026: live RockHouse events list plus 9 Wayback captures; gaps (Jan–early Feb 2025, Dec 2025–Jan 2026, May–Jun 2026) filled from Songkick (venue 34146) pages 2, 4 and 8
venues.notes: Bills come from titles separated by '~' (every act on the bill) and from Songkick line-ups. Dropped emo, indie and dance nights, DJs and karaoke. Some solo, rap or electronic acts are still in. Songkick pages 3 and 5–7 weren't fetched, because Wayback already covered those months.

band_info.name: West Philadelphia Orchestra
band_info.description: A big Philadelphia brass-and-reeds ensemble that plays Balkan, Romani and Middle Eastern dance music, with a regular residency at the Black Squirrel Club.

band_info.name: Drew Nugent & The Midnight Society
band_info.description: A Philadelphia band led by pianist and singer Drew Nugent that plays 1920s and 30s hot jazz and dance-band music.

band_info.name: Danny Paisley & The Southern Grass
band_info.description: A traditional bluegrass band led by singer and guitarist Danny Paisley, a regular at the TileWorks bluegrass shows.

band_info.name: The Jason Carter Band
band_info.description: A bluegrass band led by fiddler Jason Carter. It played the Thanksgiving Eve 2025 show and the June 2026 bluegrass show at TileWorks.

band_info.name: Junior Sisk & Ramblers Choice
band_info.description: A hard-driving traditional bluegrass band fronted by Junior Sisk. It headlined Bluegrass at TileWorks in June 2025 and Thanksgiving Eve 2026.

band_info.name: Chris Harford & The Band of Changes
band_info.description: Songwriter Chris Harford's long-running band, a fixture of the TileWorks Thanksgiving Eve party.

band_info.name: Thinkin' Big Band
band_info.description: A big band that has played Black Squirrel Club bills more than once.

notes:
Census of 9 venues the user named. Six were identified; three could not be found: The R.A.T.T., Lev's (Jenkintown) and Soupçon. Search was thorough, and these are probably DIY or house-show names or spelled differently; the user should give a town or social handle. Black Squirrel = Black Squirrel Club in Fishtown, Philadelphia (the only music venue by that name within about an hour). Starving Artist Cafe = 18 Bridge St, Stockton NJ (other cafes with the name are in SC, NY, VT and VA). Maxwell's on Main = MOM's, 37 N Main St, Doylestown (not Hoboken). Moravian Tile Works = TileWorks, 130 E Swamp Rd, Doylestown.
Johnny Brenda's and Kung Fu Necktie: every act on every bill, from the venues' RockHouse event lists (live, plus Wayback captures of /events and the homepage), with gaps filled from Songkick gigography pages. Rows are typed 'archive' when they come from a Wayback capture. Rule-based filtering removed DJ, dance, emo, karaoke, trivia, comedy, drag and cancelled events, but some solo singer-songwriters and rap or electronic acts are still in because they can't be told apart without looking up each act. Splitting bills on commas, '+', 'w/' and '~' may occasionally break or merge a name.
The Wayback Machine refused connections (rate limit) for much of the run, so some planned captures were not fetched: TileWorks mid/late 2025, Black Squirrel Club history, the deleted Starving Artist WordPress site. Bandsintown and Heart of Jazz return 403 or a Cloudflare challenge. Black Squirrel rows for 2025 come partly from Heart of Jazz search snippets.
